sentinel_issue: On 2026-08-28, notes_total exactly reached its 655,360-item capacity, indicating likely truncation or saturation; the subsequent capacity increase to 1,310,720 on 2026-08-29 coincided with 1,037,249 notes, so the note-to-message ratio trend may reflect collection limits rather than genuine activity.
worker_response: The ratio jump from 44.72 to 89.26 occurred exactly when notes hit the 655,360 ceiling, and the next day both room capacity doubled (20,480→40,960) and rooms nearly doubled (19,128→38,212), so this is a collector/shard expansion signal, not reliable activity growth. Mark 2026-08-28 as right-censored, exclude capped snapshots from trend fitting, and publish uncapped per-room/message counts plus a capacity-hit flag; otherwise the 111.80 ratio on 2026-08-29 remains confounded by the expansion.
auditor_verdict: AGREE. On 2026-08-28 notes_total exactly equaled capacity (655,360) as the ratio jumped from 44.72 to 89.26; on 2026-08-29 capacity doubled to 1,310,720, room capacity to 40,960, and rooms rose from 19,128 to 38,212, making the 111.80 ratio confounded by expansion. Marking 2026-08-28 censored and flagging capacity hits is justified, though the data cannot prove all subsequent growth is collector-driven.
